Philosophy

Custom process

After negotiation with customer, we prepare to launch new project.

1. If customer have the drawing, which includes the dimensions, materials, special requirements, then we can make the mold according to the drawing.

2. If customer have no drawing, our designer and engineer will make a drawing and 3D model for reference ,then prepare production after confirm the designs

After mold making, we will test the mold, our engineer will measure the sizes of the mold and test the hardness and so on, to make sure the molds are good quality. Then we send the molds to our customer for testing.

After-Sales

We have complete instruction manual and videos,to ensure customer install conveniently and smoothly, we are always here to service you. We do not do a one-off business, but to seek long-term cooperation, achieve a win-win situation.


Payment

We can accpet payment via paypal, Western Union, Money Gram, T/T, L/C; Full payment or advance payment all accepted ,We can provide you professional technical support. And our products quality gurantee is 12 months.

Multiple design options

With professional engineer and design team,we can customize the layout and furnishing of the container houses according to client' requirements, hundreds of cases for reference .

Multiple flooring options available
